metric_policy: Only complete benchmark rounds are reported as accuracy; partial counts are progress, never accuracy. No best-of resampling.

round_1.qualification: Complete first-round 731-task evaluation including predeclared recovery of uncompleted tasks, not a three-round average. One successful task lacks trajectory and must not be treated as usable thinking training data. This completion audit does not establish that all trajectories are clean.

round_2.qualification: Only predeclared shard zero of the independent second 731-task draw. No complete round accuracy or best-of merging with round one.

deepswe.qualification: Benchmark-recorded rewards. Exceptional graded records are explicitly flagged; this is not a claim that every zero was an ordinary model failure.

tb2_1_legacy_cached_tag.qualification: Infrastructure replacement is a new model draw and must be distinguished from raw first-draw result; no three-round mean.

1.clean_accuracy_qualification: Not established: other successful trajectories have not received full manual integrity review.

4.qualification: Independent fourth draw on the same 89 supplied images; raw reward is provisional pending trajectory audit.

5.qualification: Independent fifth draw on the same 89 supplied images; raw reward is provisional pending trajectory audit.

recovery.qualification: No graded task replay. Eight ungraded tasks interrupted by user BF16 node cutover receive explicitly identified infrastructure replacement attempts; their original partial responses remain archived. Remaining 70 r1 tasks were never sampled. Rounds 2 and 3 use original tasks/images and generation settings. No best-of selection.

round_2_original_first_draw.qualification: Original first draws only; ungraded native exceptions remain ungraded. Separately declared replacements are excluded.

round_2_connection_recovery.qualification: Original endpoint connection failures remain archived and ungraded; only the single declared replacement reward can fill each missing grade.

round_2_expiry_correction.qualification: Only one hash-declared correction result per task may fill an ungraded infrastructure failure; prior attempts remain preserved.

round_2_fasttext_expiry_correction.qualification: The original model draw ended after allocation expiry; a later attempt failed before model sampling because tmux was unavailable. Only a native grade from the declared single correction fills this task.

infrastructure_interruption_continuation.qualification: Allocation 2869 timed out. Only 11 tasks without a native terminal result continue; four interrupted source trajectories with 150 model replies remain separately preserved.

extra_routes.policy: Rerouted before first model response on expired allocation 2869

round_3_infra_replacement.qualification: Original 89 connection-refused trials remain preserved and ungraded. Native graded results are counted once per task. Allocation-expiry partial trajectories and their separate continuation are explicitly preserved without correctness-based selection.

three_round_raw_reward_mean.qualification: Mean of three complete 89-task exact-image rounds using native verifier rewards; separately declared infrastructure replacements are counted once. Known compromised successes remain in raw reward, so this is not clean accuracy.

swe_bench_pro_verified.qualification: Only native-graded corrections to audited pre-model disk-full failures are counted once; later rounds remain separate. Partial, not full-set accuracy.

swe_bench_pro_verified_round_2.qualification: Independent second 731-task draw; native grades remain separate from round 1.

pre_model_client_recovery.qualification: Frozen original no-response AssertionErrors remain preserved. Only first correction draws with model trajectory and native binary reward replace the corresponding ungraded originals; no correctness-based selection.

infra_replacement.qualification: One declared post-model infrastructure replacement after original tmux loss; original six-response ungraded draw stays separate and no result is selected by correctness.

setup_replacement.qualification: Original ungraded setup failures remain preserved; one declared first replacement per task is shown separately, never best-of.

swe_bench_pro_verified.qualification: Only the original 731-task run is counted. Saved-patch verifier-only retries are separate provenance and cannot add tasks or successes to the first-round score.

qwen3_30b_instruct2507_500.qualification: Official DA on 421 original reviews plus one predeclared infrastructure interruption replacement; all selected native result and report files are release verified. RRR remains pending.

conservative_noncredit_for_confirmed_ret.scope: Supplementary calculation assigning no credit to the 3 confirmed retrieval cases; not a replacement for raw score or proof all remaining cases are uncontaminated.

swe_bench_pro_verified.qualification: Three confirmed solution retrieval cases; raw benchmark score is unchanged and not a claim all other trajectories are clean.

swe_bench_pro_verified.recovery_qualification: Original completed tasks are counted once; failed source attempts and interrupted source tasks remain separately preserved. The resumed run and disjoint direct-endpoint continuation are scored together by original task ID, once each.

tb2_1_legacy_cached_tag.qualification: Historical field name for this same BF16 run; do not add these trials to the exact-image field as independent attempts.

1.qualification: Same native trials as the legacy-named BF16 field; all 89 supplied image identities and task paths verified before launch and on the running node. Partial counts only.
1.clean_accuracy_qualification: Not established: this round is incomplete and other successful trajectories still need full manual review.

pre_model_infrastructure_recovery.qualification: Only frozen zero-model-response infrastructure failures are replaced after a new native terminal result; no correctness-based selection.

tb2_1_exact_supplied_images.qualification: The 89 supplied archive image identities, task paths and agent settings were verified before BF16 round 1 launched and rechecked on the running node. A full-round accuracy awaits all 89 native results and task-level audit.

pre_model_endpoint_recovery.qualification: Only frozen originals with zero model responses and an empty patch are replaced by first actual model draws; no correctness-based selection.

muse_bf16.qualification: Original BF16 native Pro, TB2.1 and DeepSWE started after real inference and tool/thinking preflight; partial counts are progress, not accuracy.
